description.value: Pho Super Bowl is a Vietnamese restaurant serving fresh, aromatic pho and a broad menu of noodle soups, vermicelli bowls, rice plates, and appetizers at its Coquitlam strip-mall location. The restaurant emphasises house-made broth developed over years of recipe refinement and offers delivery in addition to dine-in service. A second location operates in Burnaby, making this a small local chain with a loyal following in the Metro Vancouver area.

The OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but both the OSM address tags and the website clearly place this restaurant in Coquitlam — a notable discrepancy to flag.
